svg.title: Illustrative Lifeguard suspicion timeline
svg.desc: Suspicion starts at zero with a six-second deadline. A distinct additional reporter at one second shortens the deadline to four seconds from the original start. A duplicate at two seconds changes nothing. Alternative outcomes show a valid newer owner Alive processed at three seconds canceling the old timer, or expiry at four seconds after state and persistence checks. Durations are illustrative, not Numax defaults.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(77, 57, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
t = 0 s: first suspicion
Capture epoch 7, incarnation 1
Deadline = 6 s

div.style: color: rgb(77, 57, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
t = 1 s: distinct additional reporter
Deadline becomes 4 s from t = 0
3 s remain; the old 6 s deadline is replaced

div.style: color: rgb(77, 57, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
t = 2 s: same report delivered again
Not a new reporter
Deadline stays at 4 s

div.style: color: rgb(21, 60, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
t = 3 s: valid owner Alive is processed
Same open epoch 7, newer incarnation 2

div.style: color: rgb(21, 60, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Apply Alive; cancel the old suspicion
Any queued old expiry has no effect

div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
t = 4 s: no valid refutation processed
Expiry must still match the current
epoch, incarnation and suspicion timer

div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Persist required rejection floor
If persistence fails: report local degradation
Do not publish a successful Dead transition

div.style: color: rgb(91, 32, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Only after successful required persistence:
publish Dead as a local failure judgment
Not identity revocation or proof of data loss
